hints.title: Evaluate Three Separate Conditions
hints.text: The optimal answer is the minimum cost among: a strictly less than b, b strictly less than a, or both reduced to one identical character.

hints.title: Prefix Character Frequencies
hints.text: Count frequencies of each letter a through z in both strings to compute prefix totals in constant time.

hints.title: Iterate Alphabet Split Points
hints.text: For boundary letter c from a to y, all characters in first string must be <= c and all in second string > c.

hints.title: Full Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def minCharacters(self, a: str, b: str) -> int:
        m, n = len(a), len(b)
        cnt_a = [0] * 26
        cnt_b = [0] * 26
        for c in a:
            cnt_a[ord(c) - ord('a')] += 1
        for c in b:
            cnt_b[ord(c) - ord('a')] += 1

        ans = (m - max(cnt_a)) + (n - max(cnt_b))

        pref_a = 0
        pref_b = 0
        for i in range(25):
            pref_a += cnt_a[i]
            pref_b += cnt_b[i]
            cost1 = (m - pref_a) + pref_b
            cost2 = (n - pref_b) + pref_a
            ans = min(ans, cost1, cost2)

        return ans
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all individual character substitutions takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting 26 character frequencies allows evaluating all boundary conditions in O(26) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate checks all 25 boundary splits for conditions 1 and 2, and all 26 characters for condition 3.
